title: Debiasing Multimodal Large Language Models via Penalization of Language Priors

bias_targets.methodology: Probing multimodal models with visual questions paired with meaningless, noisy, or completely absent visual inputs to observe unwarranted confidence driven by textual priors, analyzing attention weight distributions between text and image tokens, and evaluating object hallucination rates on multimodal benchmarks like POPE, MME, and MMMU.
